description: Create 3 Raycast Snippets that use dynamic placeholders, then verify each works by triggering it in a real TextEdit document. (1) Keyword '!iso' — snippet text uses Raycast's {date format="YYYY-MM-DD"} placeholder so it expands to today's date in ISO format. (2) Keyword '!sig' — snippet text is 'Best,\n\nClaude' with the {cursor} placeholder on the blank middle line. (3) Keyword '!rev' — snippet text is 'Reviewing: {clipboard}' which inserts the current clipboard contents. After creating all 3 snippets: open a new TextEdit plain-text document, trigger '!iso' (it should expand to today's date), then trigger '!sig' (it should expand to Best, / [blank] / Claude), then copy the text 'PR #42' to the clipboard and trigger '!rev' (it should expand to 'Reviewing: PR #42'). Save the resulting TextEdit document to ~/Desktop/snippet_test.txt. Finally, export your snippet collection to ~/Desktop/snippets_live.raycastsnippets.
